pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Dark brown contiguous regions exhibit complex, non-uniform polygonal geometries with highly serrated, stellate edge gradients. Margin angularity is high, featuring numerous acute protrusions extending into the lighter inter-patch spaces.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Light-colored negative space forms a continuous, interconnected topological graph. Junction nodes are predominantly tri-radial (Y-junctions). Corridor thickness is relatively thin and fluctuates where patch vertices converge.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane along the dorsal neck and shoulder displays a consistent, low-amplitude serrated silhouette. The frequency of the dark bristly hair clusters creates a jagged 1D contour against the out-of-focus background.
